grader_prompt: You are evaluating whether an optimize skill run produced correct, high-quality output. Review the agent's output text, any generated ScanPolicy JSON, the stackhawk.yml diff, and the hawk op/hawk commands executed. For each check below, determine pass/fail and write a one-sentence explanation. Return a JSON object conforming to rubric-schema.json.

checks.description: The run detects the codebase's actual languages/frameworks/DBs from evidence files (e.g. package.json, pom.xml, requirements.txt, Dockerfile) rather than guessing.
Optimization is expressed as a trial scan policy referenced via stackhawk.yml app.scanPolicy.name, NOT by mutating the app's own tech flags/plugins.

An initial trial scan runs; any further scans occur only as part of the tiered refine loop (capped at 3 iterations) to verify applied levers — not unbounded re-scanning. After refinement settles, the user is asked to promote or discard.
checks.focus: hawk scan invocations; the decision prompt

checks.description: Discard deletes the trial policy and restores the stackhawk.yml backup, leaving the app in its original state.

When scan metrics show rate-limited/timeout-prone, the run lowers hawk.scan.concurrentRequests automatically; when a path is heavy/slow it PROPOSES app.excludePaths with a diff rather than auto-excluding; auth-wall is surfaced for the user to configure (never fabricated).
checks.focus: the refine loop: commands executed, stackhawk.yml diff, the auto-vs-confirm tiering
